requirements.description: Alphabet FY2025 10-K: the reportable segments (Google Services, Google Cloud, Other Bets, and Alphabet-level activities) and, for each, the source's definition of principal products, services and activities, including complete enumerations (Google Services core products, performance and brand advertising bullets, non-advertising revenue list; Google Cloud offerings and list including Agents sub-items; Other Bets examples and revenue sources), with necessary qualifiers.
